label: Tier 1
name: Metro / global city
cities: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad
worldview: Cosmopolitan, time-poor, optionality-seeking. Buys outcomes and identity, not just products.
decision: Research online, compare three options, consult 2-3 trusted people, then buy fast. High expectation of service.
trust: Peer reviews, creators, global media, evidence. Low patience for bad UX.
money: Cash-flow comfortable but leveraged. EMI normalised. Price sensitivity is 'value per month', not sticker.
media: X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, podcasts, OTT

label: Tier 2
name: Emerging city
cities: Lucknow, Jaipur, Indore, Kochi, Coimbatore, Nagpur, Patna, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Surat
worldview: Aspirational and family-anchored. Wants metro amenities without metro anonymity.
decision: WhatsApp the family, watch 2 YouTube reviews, ask the local dealer, negotiate hard, then commit.
trust: Family, local dealer, YouTube reviewer, community. Authority matters.
money: EMI-driven, festival-cycle spending, gold as savings, cash still king for big tickets.
media: YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, local news, ShareChat

label: Tier 3
name: District town
cities: Gorakhpur, Bareilly, Warangal, Belagavi, Jabalpur, Agra, Siliguri, Udaipur, Hisar, Nanded
worldview: Transitional. Sees the metro on a screen and lives the district on the ground. Highly relational.
decision: Ask the person who already bought it, check the service centre, bargain, consult a 'knowledgeable' cousin.
trust: Known people, local repairman, doctor/teacher, shopkeeper. Sceptical of distant brands.
money: Seasonal, cash + UPI, small-ticket EMIs, high penalty for a wrong purchase.

label: Tier 4
name: Rural / small town
cities: Sitapur, Purnia, Kalahandi, Yavatmal, Barmer, Dumka, Bastar, Barpeta
worldview: Subsistence-first, community-shaped. Weather, harvest and family events set the calendar.
decision: Consult family/community, rely on the dealer/ASHA/panchayat, avoid unfamiliar commitments, prefer cash.
trust: Family, village institutions, local authority, religious/community networks. Low trust in distant institutions.
money: Irregular income, cash, chit funds, SHG loans, gold, informal credit.
media: WhatsApp, YouTube, TV, radio, ShareChat, word of mouth
